column1: # tools/css/gen-atrule-tables.py: the scope ledger of the at-rules of the pin (CSS Conditional, Fonts, Counter Styles, Paged Media, Animations, View Transitions, Anchor Positioning, Color,
# Namespaces, Mixins, Navigation). One row per at-rule of the pin (the pin has 48). Tab separated:
#  parents     where the rule may be, comma separated: top (a style sheet), group (inside a conditional group rule, @layer or @scope), style (inside a style rule), page (inside @page), mixin
#  validates   the block is validated against the registry's grammars
#  applies     a condition evaluates or the rule is looked up or cascaded (a typed set, the sheet, the layer registry)
#  typed       there is a typed accessor (css_font_rules.h, css_counter_style.h, css_page.h, css_keyframes.h, css_atrule.h)
#  preserved   recognized and inactive: kept as component values, serialized, never applied
